title: DV Jewellery Designer
desc: A premium jewellery e-commerce experience showcasing gold, silver, platinum, rings, earrings, bracelets, charms, and necklaces, with features such as order tracking, fast delivery, free returns, and customer services.
challenge: High-ticket luxury jewelry requires deep tactile trust, intricate piece inspection, and seamless checkout to convert discerning online buyers.
approach: Architected a digital flagship boutique blending high-fashion editorial storytelling with intuitive jewelry filtering and high-resolution piece inspection.
results: Elevated brand presence, intuitive category navigation, and fluid mobile checkout experience.

title: SEOGram
desc: An SEO-focused website offering services such as SEO consultancy, content marketing, keyword research, on-site SEO, SEO analysis, and pricing plans for different levels of service.
challenge: Structuring complex digital marketing offerings, service tiers, and audit capabilities into a high-converting, easy-to-digest agency interface.
approach: Engineered clear visual hierarchy, transparent tier comparison modules, and conversion-focused calls to action across all service lines.
results: Clear service differentiation, transparent pricing communication, and streamlined consultation inquiries.

title: Konsept
desc: A home and interior-decoration website focused on minimal and simple design, interior inspiration, collections, decoration ideas, and related content.
challenge: Presenting understated interior aesthetics and editorial decor inspiration without clunky navigation or slow imagery.
approach: Applied a minimalist layout system with balanced whitespace, curated project galleries, and responsive visual storytelling.
results: Immersive visual showcase, seamless multi-device browsing, and rapid content delivery.

title: Fintecc
desc: A modern fintech/business software project designed around digital tools and workflows for accounting and CA firms.
challenge: Translating intricate chartered accountancy workflows, ledger tools, and business compliance requirements into an accessible SaaS interface.
approach: Built structured information architecture, clear feature categorization, and enterprise-grade design patterns for accounting professionals.
results: Streamlined accounting workflow visualization, modern SaaS aesthetics, and high clarity across software modules.

title: Shreeji Fashion
desc: A fashion-focused website showcasing designer ethnic wear and Chaniya Choli collections, with a strong visual shopping experience.
challenge: Highlighting handcrafted fabric detail, color richness, and festive collections on mobile screens for festival and bridal shoppers.
approach: Designed a dynamic lookbook interface with vibrant color contrasts, mobile-optimized catalog grids, and quick inquiry triggers.
results: High visual engagement for festive collections, fast-scrolling catalog, and straightforward customer browsing.

title: Nexode
desc: A modern digital design and product-studio website focused on presenting creative digital products, design capabilities, and product-oriented work.
challenge: Creating an impactful digital presence that communicates technical rigor alongside progressive creative direction.
approach: Implemented dark theme contrast, smooth micro-interactions, responsive typography, and modular capability blocks.
results: Memorable studio brand identity, smooth navigation flow, and crisp showcase of digital craft.
